Maya: Quick post-allhands follow-up: RCA for the outage is live. Please skim and claim action items. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4472
ops-bot: RCA INC-4472 created. Postmortem page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RCAs/pages/INC-4472
Devon: I'll take the rollout checklist + infra verification. ETA 36h.
Ravi: I can own runtime traces and KV cache dumps. Will post findings as bullets.
CS: Customer note: two Dedicated customers saw errors (Acme & BlueWave). Who is drafting outbound?
Maya: Devon will draft the technical blurb; CS will handle tone/send.
Devon: Requesting temporary access to 2 test GPUs for perf validation. Maya, can you approve?
Maya: Approved for 48h. Ops, please tag as INC-4472-test.
ops-bot: Resources allocated and tagged: inc-4472-test-a, inc-4472-test-b. Canary window scheduled: 2026-04-10T20:00:00Z.
Ravi: Quick note: initial traces point to a batching edge with prefix eviction at high QPS. Adding detailed logs to RCA.
Devon: Adding action items to table: - Infra verification: Devon (36h) - Runtime traces & KV dumps: Ravi (24h) - Canary with guard: Ops (scheduled) - Customer comms: CS <- Devon (10h) - Post-canary QA: Maya/Product (72h)
eng-lead: Leadership ask: please include a short mitigation plan in the one-pager for execs (2 bullets: short-term config guard, long-term kernel patch).
Maya: Will prepare one-pager and post in ~4h. Please add status reactions when you update the table.
CS: I'll draft customer-friendly language once Devon posts the tech paragraph.
Ravi: Starting trace collection now; will update with any kernel anomalies.
Devon: Marked owners in the action table. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks all. Closing the thread for now; will post the one-pager and owners link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RCAs/pages/INC-4472-actions
